name: Laujar de Andarax (Spain)
description: Red field with a white wavy diagonal band bearing a blue wavy stripe, from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Laujar de Andarax (a ship and a castle on red).
history: Municipal flag of Laujar de Andarax; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: wavy diagonal band with a blue wavy stripe
